messages:
sam_support: Customer tenant t-09f3 reports they cannot launch models from the Console — launch button is disabled and client gets a 403 when calling /v1/models/launch. Screenshots attached in ticket.
sam_support: Error from UI hook: `HTTP 403 Forbidden - insufficient_scope: required role(s): model.launch or model.executor`.
ashok: thanks — was there a role rename in the last RBAC refactor? I remember a change last night.
maria: yes, deployed a canary for the role cleanup at ~1842093000 (PR #3214). we renamed a bunch of bits: `model.launcher` -> `model.executor` and consolidated billing scopes.
ryan: tenant-role-bridge still maps tenants to old role keys — if it doesn't find the alias it returns deny by default. reproducing now.
ryan: audit logs from tenant-role-bridge for t-09f3:
```
ts=2026-03-20T14:01:02Z level=info tenant=t-09f3 req_id=aa5f role_lookup=cache_miss lookup_key=model.launcher -> not_found
ts=2026-03-20T14:01:02Z level=warn tenant=t-09f3 req_id=aa5f decision=deny reason=missing_role_mapping
```
leah: can we do a quick mitigation? patching mapping for that tenant to point old->new until bridge gets updated.
leah: applied temporary mapping via admin API:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/admin/role-mappings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-09f3","old_role":"model.launcher","new_role":"model.executor","reason":"canary-mismatch temporary mapping"}'
```
support-bot: Synthetic check for t-09f3: model launch endpoint now returns 200 for sample run (latency 240ms).
sam_support: confirmed with customer — they can launch again, thanks team :tada:
ashok: root cause: PR renamed roles but the tenant-role-bridge upgrade that applies alias translations wasn't included in the canary rollout. missing migration step.
maria: noted. follow-ups:
- rollback safe path: add compatibility alias during rollouts
- add e2e test that simulates tenant-specific role mappings
- update release runbook to include a preflight check for tenant-role-bridge compatibility
ryan: I'll open an incident PR to add the alias auto-fill and schedule a small migration job to backfill all tenants.
leah: I'll leave the temporary mapping in place for 24h and then expire it after backfill verification. will log audit entry.
support-bot: Audit event created: ae-1842109876-01 (temporary_mapping applied by leah for t-09f3)
sam_support: closing ticket after customer confirmation. please add the migration PR link here when ready.
